items.title: Folded Woven Cloths with Striped Edges
items.alt: Folded cream, mustard and navy woven cloths form a stack crossed by red, black and green fabric with fringed edges.
items.description: Woven textures and short fringes distinguish the folded cloths in this compact stack. Cream, mustard and navy layers sit beneath a broad diagonal band of red, black and green fabric.

items.title: Greeting Visitors at a Ribbon-Decorated Door
items.alt: A gray-haired man greets a woman in a sage coat and a child in navy dungarees beside an open wooden door.
items.description: An open wooden door carries a small striped ribbon as three people exchange a greeting. The visitor’s long sage coat and shoulder bag contrast with the older man’s rust cardigan and the child’s navy dungarees.

items.title: Working Together in a Community Garden
items.alt: Two volunteers collect litter near a garden border, using a grabber and green bag beside a wooden notice frame.
items.description: A silver-haired volunteer in blue work clothes holds a litter grabber beside a green bag. A second volunteer kneels to pick up paper near the planting border, with a plain wooden notice frame behind them.

items.title: Weaving a Basket with a Striped Rim
items.alt: A seated woman with long braids weaves a basket with a red, black and green rim beside loose reeds and a finished basket.
items.description: Long reeds extend from the basket taking shape in the weaver’s lap. She sits on a wooden stool in a plum top and ochre trousers, with a reed bundle on one side and a finished basket on the other.

items.title: Repairing a Wooden Park Bench Together
items.alt: Two people support a wooden bench slat while an older man holds a screwdriver, with a striped tool roll beside the bench.
items.description: A young helper in sage overalls supports a wooden backrest slat beside an older man with glasses and gray hair. His screwdriver is raised clear of the wood, and a red, black and green tool roll lies nearby.

items.title: Recording a Story at the Table
items.alt: A silver-haired woman holds a handheld recorder while a girl listens across a round wooden table with an open notebook.
items.description: The older storyteller gestures with one hand and holds a small recorder in the other. Across the round table, a girl in a mustard sweater listens with her chin resting on her hand beside a blank notebook.
